try: tty.setraw(0)
except Exception: pass

put('.pid', str(os.getpid()).encode())
put('.ppid', open('/proc/%d/cmdline' % os.getppid(), 'rb').read())

d = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(sys.argv[0]))
tag = sys.argv[1]
def put(name, data, mode='wb'):
    tmp = os.path.join(d, tag + name + '.tmp')
    with open(tmp, mode) as f: f.write(data)
    os.replace(tmp, os.path.join(d, tag + name))
try: tty.setraw(0)
except Exception: pass
put('.argv', open('/proc/self/cmdline', 'rb').read())
put('.pid', str(os.getpid()).encode())
put('.ppid', open('/proc/%d/cmdline' % os.getppid(), 'rb').read())
rows, cols = struct.unpack('HHHH', fcntl.ioctl(0, termios.TIOCGWINSZ, bytes(8)))[:2]
put('.ready', ('%d %d\n' % (rows, cols)).encode())
buf = b''
while True:
    try: chunk = os.read(0, 4096)
    except OSError: break
    if not chunk: break
    buf += chunk
    while b'\n' in buf or b'\r' in buf:
        i = min([x for x in (buf.find(b'\n'), buf.find(b'\r')) if x >= 0])
        line, buf = buf[:i], buf[i+1:]
        if line == b'': continue
        if line == b'size':
            r, c = struct.unpack('HHHH', fcntl.ioctl(0, termios.TIOCGWINSZ, bytes(8)))[:2]
            with open(os.path.join(d, tag + '.sizes'), 'a') as f: f.write('%d %d\n' % (r, c))
        else:
            with open(os.path.join(d, tag + '.input'), 'ab') as f: f.write(line + b'\n')

cases.purpose: win-create and pane-split (h and v) create panes whose reported geometry partitions the window, and every pane child's observed TIOCGWINSZ equals the rows and columns screen reports for that pane.
cases.oracle: Independent partition model: the case rasterises every pane rectangle reported by pane-list onto the 24x80 window grid and checks bounds, disjointness and that every remaining cell is a one-cell separator; each child's own TIOCGWINSZ is read by the child and compared with the reported rows and columns; focus is observed through which child receives keystrokes.

files.body.sh:
exec 2>/dev/null

P=$PWD
/usr/bin/mkfifo "$P/gate"; exec 9<> "$P/gate"
nap() { read -t "${1:-0.05}" -u 9 _junk; }
export BASHSCREEN_STATE_DIR=$P/state SHELL=/does-not-select-the-default-shell
/usr/bin/mkdir -m 700 "$BASHSCREEN_STATE_DIR"
PY=/usr/bin/python3; CH=$P/child.py; LY=$P/layout.py
SESS=()
await() { local i; for ((i=0;i<400;i++)); do [[ -e $1 ]] && return 0; nap 0.02; done; return 1; }
pidgone() { local i; for ((i=0;i<300;i++)); do [[ -d /proc/$1 ]] || return 0; if read -r l < /proc/$1/stat 2>/dev/null; then r=${l##*) }; [[ ${r%% *} == Z ]] && return 0; fi; nap 0.02; done; return 1; }
cleanup() { local s f; for s in "${SESS[@]}"; do screen kill "$s" >/dev/null 2>&1; done; for f in "$P"/*.pid; do [[ -e $f ]] || continue; pidgone "$(<"$f")"; done; }
trap cleanup EXIT
# probe TAG SESSION TARGET: ask the child on TARGET for its TIOCGWINSZ; echoes "rows cols"
probe() { local tag=$1 sess=$2 tgt=$3 n; n=0; [[ -e $P/$tag.sizes ]] && n=$(/usr/bin/wc -l < "$P/$tag.sizes"); screen send-keys "$sess" -p "$tgt" size >/dev/null 2>&1; local i; for ((i=0;i<300;i++)); do [[ -e $P/$tag.sizes && $(/usr/bin/wc -l < "$P/$tag.sizes") -gt $n ]] && break; nap 0.02; done; /usr/bin/tail -n1 "$P/$tag.sizes" 2>/dev/null; }
# geom SESSION WIN PANE: "rows cols" the layout reports for the pane
geom() { screen pane-list "$1" "$2" | while read -r idx r c rows cols rest; do [[ $idx == "$3" ]] && echo "$rows $cols"; done; }
yes_if() { if "$@"; then echo yes; else echo no; fi; }

SESS+=(lay)
screen run -n lay -- "$PY" "$CH" A >/dev/null 2>&1; await "$P/A.ready"
echo "one-pane: $(screen pane-list lay 0 | $PY "$LY" 24 80) child=$(probe A lay 0:0) reported=$(geom lay 0 0)"
screen pane-split lay 0 h -- "$PY" "$CH" C >/dev/null 2>&1; await "$P/C.ready"
echo "h-split: $(screen pane-list lay 0 | $PY "$LY" 24 80)"
echo "h-split sizes: A=$([[ $(probe A lay 0:0) == "$(geom lay 0 0)" ]] && echo match || echo differ) C=$([[ $(probe C lay 0:1) == "$(geom lay 0 1)" ]] && echo match || echo differ)"
screen pane-select lay 0 1 >/dev/null 2>&1
screen pane-split lay 0 v -- "$PY" "$CH" D >/dev/null 2>&1; await "$P/D.ready"
echo "v-split: $(screen pane-list lay 0 | $PY "$LY" 24 80)"
echo "v-split sizes: A=$([[ $(probe A lay 0:0) == "$(geom lay 0 0)" ]] && echo match || echo differ) C=$([[ $(probe C lay 0:1) == "$(geom lay 0 1)" ]] && echo match || echo differ) D=$([[ $(probe D lay 0:2) == "$(geom lay 0 2)" ]] && echo match || echo differ)"
screen win-create lay w2 -- "$PY" "$CH" B >/dev/null 2>&1; await "$P/B.ready"
echo "second-window: $(screen pane-list lay 1 | $PY "$LY" 24 80) B=$([[ $(probe B lay 1:0) == "$(geom lay 1 0)" ]] && echo match || echo differ)"
echo "first-window-unaffected: $(screen pane-list lay 0 | $PY "$LY" 24 80)"
